meta.name: MemeTracker
meta.shortDescription: Track Dogecoin payments to an address (mempool + tip blocks)
meta.longDescription: MemeTracker watches Dogecoin P2P for payments to tracked P2PKH addresses. Mempool matching is primary; a tip-focused header/block safeguard (~24h of headers) is backup for payments that skip relay and mine immediately. Matched txs show confirmations (0–5). Optional access control: IP allowlist (full admin), admin_token (web UI + API via /{admin_token}/), and user_token (/{user_token}/track and /healthz only). Built from https://github.com/qlpqlp/memetracker (v0.0.6). DogeBOX env seeds memetracker_config.json on first boot so P2P can auto-start. Parallel P2P sessions (default 3); for maximum reliability set P2P_HOST to your own Dogecoin Core.

sections.name: Access and Security
sections.description: IP allowlist grants full admin access. Admin token unlocks web UI and /api via /{token}/. User token only allows /{token}/track and /{token}/healthz. Tokens must differ. Values seed first-boot config and override via env on start.
